text.offer: At the end of the valley are the crumbling ruins of a city older than Berg, and the greatest of the minotaurs keep their lairs there. Clear six of them out of the ruins, and the valley will be ours again.
text.progress: The ruins lie at the far end of the Valley of Death.
text.complete: The ruins are clear. You have done what no one in Berg believed could be done.

steps.objective: Minotaurs slain in the Crumbling Ruins
